text:
olivia-peopleops: urgent — ben just pinged me: his 02/28 paystub went negative after returning from unpaid sabbatical. health premiums and 401k deductions look like they were re-enabled twice. payroll cutoff is today, can someone take a look? @mike-payroll 

ben-eng: yep that’s right. I returned 2/15, my paystub shows two lines for medical premium and two 401k deferrals, net pay = -$72. I attached a screenshot in DM. 

mike-payroll: thanks — can you paste the paystub snippet here (redact full SSN) and confirm employee ID and the pay period? if we have to do an off-cycle reversal we need manager OK. 

ben-eng: employee id 82431, last4 4321, pay period 02/16-02/28. snippet:
```
Gross: $3,846.15
Fed Tax: -$450.00
State Tax: -$120.00
401k (pre): -$384.62
401k (pre) - duplicate: -$384.62
Medical-premium: -$150.00
Medical-premium - duplicate: -$150.00
Net Pay: -$72. (direct deposit failed)
```

anna-hrbp: noting — his manager (sasha) verbally approved return 2/15 and submitted re-enrollment 2/16. lila-benefits, did the benefits team process any re-enrollment twice? 

lila-benefits: checking. benefits admin UI shows a single reenroll event on 2/16 at 11:07am, processed to carrier. no duplicate there. but benefits webhook to payroll shows two messages at 14:03 and 14:04 with same payload (suspect transient retry). i'll attach the webhook logs to the HR ticket. 

payroll-bot: Scheduled payroll run for 02/28 closes in 3h 12m. Off-cycle reversals require manual approval and a payroll ticket. 

mike-payroll: ok — likely duplicate webhook created duplicate deduction lines during payroll import. plan: 1) hold finalization for 02/28 for this employee 2) create off-cycle reversal to credit duplicate amounts 3) reconcile with carrier if needed and ensure only one premium deducted going forward. I can do 2) if manager signs off. ETA 2 hours. 

olivia-peopleops: manager (sasha) approved in DM and ok'd off-cycle. sasha confirmed with ben too. :thumbsup: 

mike-payroll: doing reversal now — creating PR #pay-2987 and manual journal. will post confirmation when reversal posts. note: if taxes were underwithheld because of negative pay we may need to re-run taxes for the period and possibly issue W-2C if year-to-date wages change materially. i'll flag for EOY review. 

ben-eng: thank you! please confirm when deposit reflects. 

mike-payroll: reversal posted at 1951234579, transaction id REV-82431-0228. net pay corrected to $1,439.70 (took out duplicate deductions). notifying banking for off-cycle deposit.

lila-benefits: i removed the duplicate webhook entry from the integration queue and added a guard to ignore identical payloads within 5 minutes. opened benefits ticket B-1129 for carrier reconciliation. 

olivia-peopleops: perfect — closing loop. mike, pls follow up if W-2 adjustment needed. tagging for visibility: @finance @legal.
